BiblicalUsage: Zepho is a son of Eliphaz and a grandson of Esau, named among the chiefs of Edom. In Genesis 36:11, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz. The fuller story is told on the Zepho profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zepho belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
